breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction between using a "gamma-centered" k-point grid and a "half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack" mesh. The ground truth removes the conflicting "half shift" instruction. The agent, however, repeated the original flawed instruction verbatim: "Use a gamma-centered, automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift for k-point sampling." These two types of k-point grids are mutually exclusive.
